scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter proovra-web dev & pnpm --filter proovra-mobile dev
scripts._dev_stack_notes: Phase CAPTURE-ARTIFACT-PIPELINE — the report worker is a SEPARATE process. Without it every Capture hangs at SIGNED forever because nothing consumes the BullMQ `report` queue (no Report/VerificationPackage row is ever created). `pnpm dev` (below) starts API + worker + web concurrently using pnpm's built-in --parallel runner. Use dev:api / dev:worker / dev:web for individual processes.
scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --filter proovra-api --filter proovra-worker --filter proovra-web run dev
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @proovra/shared build && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared-evidence-presentation build && pnpm --filter @proovra/shared-billing build && pnpm --filter @proovra/ui build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-api build
scripts.build:worker: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter proovra-worker build
